personal.name: Muhammad Fahmi Al Kahfi
personal.title: Mechanical Engineer | Researcher | Problem Solver | Leader
personal.about:
I am a final-year Mechanical Engineering student at Universitas Diponegoro, specializing in fluid mechanics, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), and energy conversion systems. With a GPA of 3.64/4.00 and hands-on research experience at the Mechanical Fluid and Thermal Research Lab, I bridge rigorous analytical thinking with real-world engineering execution.

Beyond technical mastery, I have led large-scale national events, managed cross-functional teams of 100+ members, and driven measurable outcomes through structured project management frameworks. As Executive Director of INCEPTION 2025 — the biggest petroleum event at Undip — I secured 90+ competing teams from across Indonesia and grew an audience of 154,000. I do not just solve problems — I architect solutions.

research.title: Mechanical Fluid and Thermal Research Lab
research.description:
Conducting advanced research in fluid mechanics and thermal systems using industry-grade simulation tools. Working on cutting-edge projects involving computational fluid dynamics (CFD) with ANSYS Fluent and Discrete Element Method (DEM) simulations with ESSS Rocky.

Responsibilities include setting up simulation models, running parametric studies, validating computational results against experimental data, and contributing to research reports and documentation. This lab experience directly shapes my ability to apply theoretical engineering principles to complex, real-world problems.

hard.description: Proficient in 2D and 3D engineering design using AutoCAD and SOLIDWORKS. Certified as SOLIDWORKS CAD Design Associate (CSWA) in 2025. Applied in professional internship work designing heat exchanger components to TEMA and ASME standards.

hard.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics
hard.description: Experienced in simulating complex fluid flow and heat transfer phenomena using ANSYS Fluent. Applied in research projects at the MFT Research Lab for thermal analysis, turbulence modeling, and experimental validation of theoretical fluid dynamic models.

projects.title: Offshore Wind Farm Development Potential Study
projects.headline: Assessing Rote Island's offshore wind energy potential in collaboration with PLN
projects.description: Spearheaded the spatial and technical feasibility study for a 75 MW offshore wind farm in Rote Island, successfully balancing high renewable energy potential against extreme environmental challenges such as severe seismic risks and deep-sea bathymetry. Employing a data-driven, problem-solving approach, I conducted comprehensive wind prospecting, evaluated floating foundation solutions for depths up to 131 meters, and formulated earthquake-resistant structural mitigations. Ultimately, this analysis produced a strategic recommendation framework that validated the project's technical viability, ensured long-term operational safety, and optimally aligned with local transmission grid capacities.

projects.title: Geothermal Development Case Study — IPFest 2024
projects.headline: 2nd Runner Up national geothermal engineering competition
projects.description: Served as the Team Leader (CEO) of the GEOMECH team for the Muara Laboh geothermal field development project. I spearheaded the integration of diverse, specialized expertise from team members into a single, cohesive 80 MW development strategy. Acting as the central bridge, I unified geoscience (3G) data analysis, the selection of a dual-flash technology system, and financial modeling into a robust US$ 223.8 million investment proposal. By actively synthesizing the varied perspectives and technical insights of my team into an integrated vision, I successfully ensured the project was not only technically feasible but also economically competitive, achieving an estimated internal rate of return (IRR) of 13%.

projects.title: Geothermal Case Competition — Derrick 2024
projects.headline: Finalist in national geothermal engineering case competition
projects.description: Reached the Finalist stage in the Derrick 2024 Geothermal Case Competition. Led the team in developing a detailed geothermal energy exploitation strategy, integrating technical engineering analysis with comprehensive environmental impact assessment and economic considerations.

projects.title: Structural Integrity & Code Compliance Analysis: Shell & Tube Heat Exchanger
projects.headline: Industrial heat exchanger design and optimization at PT. Rekayasa Industri
projects.description: Conducted a rigorous structural integrity and code compliance analysis for a Shell and Tube Heat Exchanger (STHX) at an Effluent Water Treatment Plant during an EPC engineering internship at PT Rekayasa Industri. I calculated the minimum required shell thickness (9.81 mm) based on ASME Section VIII and TEMA standards to mitigate risks of structural failure, overpressure, and sulfide corrosion. By comparing the theoretical minimum with the actual 19 mm design, I validated the equipment's operational safety while proposing strategic material cost optimizations and identifying critical documentation errors in the mechanical data sheet.

projects.title: Thermal Design & CFD-DEM Analysis: Horizontal Drum Dryer for Biomass Pellets
projects.headline: Collaborative Study with PUSLITBANG PLN
projects.description: Developed the thermodynamic analytical framework and assisted in the CFD-DEM (Computational Fluid Dynamics - Discrete Element Method) simulation for a horizontal drum dryer designed to process Gamal wood biomass pellets. I conducted rigorous energy balance calculations to ensure drying efficiency and assisted in modeling the complex heat-mass transfer between air and solid particles. By interpreting multi-physics simulation data, I provided critical insights to optimize residence time and heat distribution, ensuring the technical viability of high-quality biomass production for sustainable energy systems.

projects.title: Advanced Multiphase Flow Analysis
projects.headline: Coupled CFD-DEM Simulation of Cyclone Separator
projects.description: Implemented an Eulerian-Lagrangian framework via advanced coupled CFD-DEM simulations to analyze gas-solid multiphase flow dynamics within a cyclone separator. This methodology provides a massive analytical advantage over the conventional Discrete Phase Model (DPM); whereas DPM is restricted to dilute flows by treating particles as mere volume-less point-masses, CFD-DEM explicitly resolves contact mechanics for both particle-particle and particle-wall interactions. The ability of CFD-DEM to account for actual particle shapes, volume fractions, and precise collision forces enables a highly accurate two-way momentum coupling in strongly swirling turbulent zones, yielding exceptionally realistic predictions for both collection efficiency and pressure drop distribution.

projects.title: Operational Excellence & Event Strategy: ODM FT 2024
projects.headline: Orchestrating flawless logistics and creative direction for a 2,000-participant.
projects.description: As the Head of the Event Division for ODM FT 2024, I directed the end-to-end planning and execution of a large-scale orientation event, seamlessly bridging creative vision with complex operational logistics. My primary challenge involved producing a highly engaging theatrical musical drama while simultaneously engineering a strict crowd-control protocol to mobilize 2,000 attendees for a synchronized break (ishoma) within a critical 45-minute window. By implementing a structured project management approach and meticulous zonal distribution, I successfully mitigated bottlenecks and maintained a flawless schedule, resulting in an exceptional event that secured maximum satisfaction from both participating students and the Faculty of Engineering stakeholders.
